page.layout: One printed page (title page) on the scan. Centred title block from top to bottom; no margins with text. Show-through text from the reverse side (faint mirrored lines) is left out. Handwritten "2j" top right is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Habebitur disputatio publica, adversus Anabaptistarum deliria: ad diem 22. Octobris horâ locóque consuetis.
HENRICO ERNIO S. S. THEOLOgiae, in Schola Tigurina, Professore, disputabit
IOAN. BERNHARDUS FRISIUS, gregis Christi apud Kusnachtenses Pastor:
Vnus est ingenitus Deus, Pater: unus genitus Filius, Deus Verbum & homor & unus Paracletus, Spiritus veritatis.

page.notes: Greek word "τριουνωσαλω" in the title line is a rendering of the printed Greek (τριῶν ἕνωσις-like form); copied as seen, uncertain. Line "Vnus est ... homor" reads "homor" as printed, possibly "honor" with a damaged letter. Handwritten "2j" and the ink mark at top right are not printed text.
